expectations.text: Every shot prompt is self-contained: camera, lighting or style, palette and audio all appear inside the same prompt text
expectations.evidence: 8/9 blocks carry camera, lighting, style, palette, audio and avoid inline; the 9th is the deliberate look-break shot

expectations.text: Names one explicit consistency anchor — a concrete recurring visual element repeated across all shots
expectations.evidence: Anchor named: dark green wool overcoat with hand-stitched grey left cuff, its condition acting as the clock

expectations.text: Answers the stated continuity worry with concrete mechanisms, naming at least two of: fixed seed, repeated palette wording, last-frame chaining, shared grade pass
expectations.evidence: Names fixed seed, frame chaining at the seams, one continuous music bed and a shared grade pass

expectations.text: Every shot prompt carries an avoid / negative list
expectations.evidence: Avoid lists per shot, restructured so period exclusions live per-shot rather than globally

expectations.text: Warns that a specific real person cannot be held identical across clips, and offers a way around it
expectations.evidence: States Sora will not hold the real grandmother's likeness; films her entirely from behind/beside and ends on a real photograph

expectations.text: Proposes a narrative spine for the piece rather than only a list of pretty images
expectations.evidence: Spine given: Budapest Nov 1956 -> border marshes -> Austrian farmhouse -> the same coat in a modern kitchen

expectations.text: Shot count is derived from the 60s runtime and a stated clip length
expectations.evidence: 8 shots x 8s = 64s against the requested one minute
